planner.question: Can the complete crossing-record collision method extend unchanged to the exact cubic stage, or does one fixed eligible machine force injectivity?
planner.strategy: Build an explicit three-symbol quadratic-time copier and prove injectivity of its crossing sequences by splicing terminal half-tapes.
planner.alternative: Distinguish full transcripts from sound semantic pruning; use the always-rejecting copier as a concrete barrier to the unchanged method.
planner.stop_rule: No impossibility claim for reduced records or arbitrary lower bounds; no unbounded cubic failure claim.
literature_leads: Prior F038 same-U crossing and exact quadratic-stage notes; deterministic local replay. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: One fixed original program eventually scheduled at the exact cubic stage has an injective crossing-state transcript on every equal-length binary input at every interior cut.
construct.scope: Actual original three-symbol tape and exact stage k>=3 at sufficiently large n; complete crossing-state records at every interior cut, not semantic quotients.
construct.derivation: Expand raw bits to aligned blocks, duplicate input on both exterior sides, halt malformed; equal transcripts splice final halves, whose two copies must agree on mixed input.
unresolved_steps: A genuinely new asymptotic obstruction or uniform SAT cutoff.
candidate_tests: Compile actual table, exhaustive binary inputs lengths 1..8, exact copies and physical transcript uniqueness.

alternative.claim: The combined full record of every long eligible cubic-stage program cannot collide on distinct inputs; semantic pruning is not ruled out.
alternative.scope: Actual original three-symbol tape and exact stage k>=3 at sufficiently large n; complete crossing-state records at every interior cut, not semantic quotients.
alternative.derivation: Full record reconstructs the copier's sequence; its code length is constant and quadratic transition count fits cubic eventually; always-rejecting program can be omitted only with a justified change of record.
unresolved_steps: Find a sound reduced record with enough collision mass, or a different mechanism.
candidate_tests: Check actual decoder, original interpreter on normalized selectors and full clock inclusion.

objections: Must use exact original three-symbol table and charge all conversion steps.
